acceptance_gate: A proves the basis covariance of the four twist sectors, the harmonic parity of E and O in the shear, the half-shear obstruction and the duality equivalence between the consistency relation and odd-winding additivity, with exhaustive and sampled checks; B tests rectangle additivity at aspects 1, 3/2, 2 and 3, the orthogonal-basis relation on the 45-degree rotated square and the companion relations, with frozen rules and an independent checker.
objective: The owner approved a relations-not-values continuation of SC-TORUS-EXACT-20261022-001: prove that the second difference D = P00 - P10 - P01 + P11 of P(all strong components contractible) over the four twist sectors vanishes on rectangular tori, or map the shapes on which it holds and explain why. Scoping (disposable, not evidence): exhaustive enumeration of the 3 x 3 and 4 x 3 tori at every shear shows the relation fails at finite size (D = 2581/32768 on the 3 x 3 square), so it is a large-size relation. Writing E = P00 - P01 and O = P10 - P11, D = E - O; relabeling the basis makes E periodic and O antiperiodic under a full shear, so E carries whole and O half-integer harmonics, and the mirror forces O = 0 at half shear. Measured: the relation holds on rectangles of aspect 1, 3/2 and 2 and on the 45-degree rotated square in its orthogonal basis; on squares E is nearly shear-independent and O nearly O(0) cos(pi s/L), but on the 2:1 torus higher harmonics appear and a spin-splitting law O = cos(pi s/L) E fails by 22 sigma. Companion relations on rectangles: odd-winding additivity and 1 - cons10 - cons01 + cons11 = P00(contractible). A proves the exact harmonic structure and the equivalences; B maps the relations across shapes with frozen rules.
status: Complete 2026-10-23. Proved: shearing a square-lattice torus by its width relabels the twist sectors, and the mirror maps each sector to itself, for every orientation. So E = P00 - P01 carries only whole harmonics of the shear, while O = P10 - P11 carries only half-integer ones and vanishes at half shear. Additivity D = E - O = 0 is therefore a relation of one basis that shear dephases; it fails at finite size (2581/32768 on 3 x 3). Found and confirmed: the odd-line identity. For each class, the two twists odd on it give the same probability that the cone is that line: exact on small tori, accepted on 8 new tori to about 1e-5. Its stronger shear-independent form is refuted (7.3 sigma on 12 x 8). Mapped: additivity holds on rectangles of aspect 1 to 3 and on the rotated square in its own basis; on squares D(s) = D(0) + E(0)(1 - cos pi s/L). Recommendation: Continue, prove the odd-line identity (interest 2/3), deferred to the owner.
stop_rule: One bounded epic. Stop when the relations are mapped and the exact structure is proved; do not attempt a full theory of strongly-connected percolation.
